<function name="GetSuperFPTex" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Returns a floating point texture (RGBA16161616F format) the same resolution as the screen.

<note>The <page text="gmodscreenspace">Shaders/gmodscreenspace</page> doesn't behave as expected when drawing a floating-point texture to an integer texture (e.g. the default render target). Use an UnlitGeneric material instead</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="ITexture">Render target named `__rt_SuperTexture1`.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
